intended_behavior_changes: Replacement cutoff now means the first player beyond structural demand; integer starter demand N maps to replacement rank N+1.
A3 actual-ownership influence no longer changes the football replacement cutoff.
A3 league-fit scarcity no longer uses actual ownership pressure; it uses structural replacement pressure.
D starter economics consumes the Core replacement frontier instead of selecting an independent first-non-starter frontier.
Projected VOR carries canonical replacement source and cutoff provenance.
